nodes.label: install() unwraps on malicious/corrupt downloaded zip content, causing a panic
nodes.rationale: read_file_from_zip(...).unwrap()/JsonStorage::from_str_to(...).unwrap() assume packageInfo.json/hashes.json always exist and are well-formed; bad server data, network corruption, or a malicious repo crashes the client instead of failing gracefully.

nodes.label: system.rs init() never writes repo_url/repo_info back to config.json
nodes.rationale: config.json is created as literally '{}' and the default values only ever live in the in-memory HashMap; missing the JsonStorage::to_json(&config, &config_path) write-back step means every subsequent run reads a config missing these keys.

nodes.label: PackageManager::Unknown / unsupported OS branches use panic! instead of returning an error
nodes.rationale: Seven call sites in system.rs abort the whole process on an undetected package manager or non-Linux/macOS OS instead of surfacing a ClientResult error.

nodes.label: Db::execute_query/drop_table/clear_table build SQL via format! with unescaped table names
nodes.rationale: Currently only ever called with the hardcoded literal 'LocalRepo', but the API has no whitelist/escaping, so any future call site passing user input as a table name would be a SQL injection vector.

nodes.label: diesel.toml migrations_directory pointed at a pre-split absolute path that no longer exists
nodes.rationale: Made moot once the turso/geni migration plan deleted diesel.toml/schema.rs entirely and replaced the migration mechanism, but was an active footgun before that.

nodes.label: Inconsistent ownership model: Linux chown root:root vs macOS chown user:admin
nodes.rationale: The two platforms end up with different post-install ownership/management semantics for --system installs; flagged as worth unifying but explicitly left untouched by the client-source-install plan, which only inherits the existing behavior.

nodes.label: git2 declared but unused dead dependency in dpm's Cargo.toml
nodes.rationale: Originally listed alongside rusqlite/dotenv/digest/flate2/hex-literal as unused; resolved specifically for git2 once clone_package_source (client-source-install plan Task 3) started using it for real.

nodes.label: dpm-core's own Cargo.toml version is decoupled from the workspace version
nodes.rationale: dpm-core hardcodes version = '0.1.2' instead of version.workspace = true (0.1.0) like dpm/dpm-server; needs confirmation whether this is intentional (independent crates.io publish cadence) or an oversight.

nodes.label: dpm-core README's add_package example no longer matches the real function signature
nodes.rationale: The README example passed 6 positional args, but RepoInfo::add_package now needs 8 (adding entry/description); fixed later by the multi-source-namespace plan's Task 1 Step 7, which rewrote the example around add_package_version.

nodes.label: Test/dev fixture packages (test/test1/test2/helloWorld) sit alongside real repo data in dpm-server/Repo
nodes.rationale: These 4KB dev-time fixtures look like real installable packages sitting directly in the 'official' Repo directory structure, risking confusion about what's actually a real published package.

nodes.label: Infisical secrets integration completed and merged to main
nodes.rationale: Listed under 已完成 (done): justfile recipes route through infisical run, crates/dpm/.env retired, CLAUDE.md documented — merged via feat/infisical-secrets branch (commit 97b7170).
